test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2021, the Finance Minister of India announced the setting up of a Dispute Resolution Committee (DRC) for taxpayers with taxable income up to _______ and disputed income up to _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 50 lakh, Rs. 10 lakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Dispute Resolution Committee to be set up for taxpayers with taxable income up to** Rs. 50 lakh and disputed income up to Rs. 10 lakh.**
 
• In the Union Budget 2021-22, the Union Finance Minister-Nirmala Sitharaman reduced the time limit for the reopening of income tax assessment cases from six years to three years.
 
• The time limit will be 10 years for serious tax fraud cases where concealment of income is Rs 50 lakh or more with the approval of the Principal Chief Commissioner.
 
• The tax department will notify rules to remove hardships of double taxation faced by non-resident Indians (NRIs).
 
• She also announced that senior citizens above 75 years of age having an only pension and interest income would not be required to file income tax returns.
 
 
• Banks paying the interest would deduct the tax on their behalf. 
 
 
 
• 1.10 lakh taxpayers have availed of the **Direct Tax Vivad Se Vishwas scheme** to resolve tax disputes.
